_note: The recurring cast (bible §7): people met on the journey who come back. 'home': where they stand at first. 'visits': once a visit's 'when' flag holds ('wing:<id>' for a restored sanctuary wing, or a story flag) they stand there instead (the last listed that holds wins), saying 'talk' if given. People who move into the sanctuary base are visits to its rooms. A map's own 'npcs' are for people who only ever stand there (PATCH, the friends).
